summary: Backend-only testing for Les Jardiniers Normands / Pro Élagage 14 API. 10/10 pytest cases passed covering health endpoints, contact form submission with Resend email delivery, validation (422) for malformed payloads, MongoDB persistence, _id cleanup, and CORS. Resend confirmed actually sending emails (email_sent=true, email_id returned).

minor.issue: RESEND_API_KEY is committed in /app/backend/.env (real key visible). Should be considered for rotation post-launch.
No authentication/authorization — leads (PII: name/email/phone/message) are publicly readable by anyone. Should be protected before production.
No rate limiting on contact endpoint — vulnerable to spam/abuse. Consider adding throttling or captcha.

Resend is in test mode (sender onboarding@resend.dev, only verified recipient schmittantony4@gmail.com). Must verify a custom sending domain before going live to send from a branded address and to arbitrary recipients.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Add auth to GET /api/contacts to protect leads PII.
(Optional, non-blocking) Add rate limiting / honeypot / captcha on POST /api/contact.
(Required before production launch) Verify a custom sending domain in Resend and switch SENDER_EMAIL accordingly.
(Security) Rotate the RESEND_API_KEY since it has been committed to .env in the repo.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is well-structured (~140 lines) — no need to split.
Resend send wrapped in try/except so a Resend outage still persists the lead with email_sent=false — good resilience.
Mongo _id is correctly excluded via projection {"_id": 0} on GET /api/contacts.
Pydantic validation (EmailStr + Field min/max) covers required-field and email-shape edge cases — 422 returned correctly.
HTML email content escapes <,> to prevent injection — good.
CORS_ORIGINS=* is permissive but acceptable for a public marketing site contact form.
Minor: @app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: 2 TEST_-prefixed contact records inserted via POST /api/contact during testing (visible in MongoDB collection 'contacts').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API surface tested: /api/, /api/health, POST /api/contact (happy + 4 validation cases), GET /api/contacts, CORS preflight + GET. Resend integration verified working (real email_id returned). Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_contact_api.py can be re-run as regression suite. If frontend testing is requested next, focus on: contact form submission flow, French copy correctness on 11 service pages + 12 city pages + 12 blog articles, sitemap/robots presence, Open Graph tags, structured data (JSON-LD) for LocalBusiness.
